resources.string: How SubHub works
Configure Censor, app limits and Wallet rules, then run your arrangement from Home.
Dom mode
Choose features, assign apps and edit your arrangement. Keyholder can protect access with a PIN or an authenticator code.
Sub mode
Use the saved arrangement. Enter Service on Home starts protection; an active Pact can restrict when you leave.
Choose features
Enable the parts you want to use. You can change these later in Settings.
Detect selected body areas and phrases, then cover them in assigned apps. Gallery exports create censored photo and video copies.
Set daily allowances for selected apps. When time runs out, SubHub blocks access according to your saved limits.
Track tributes and payments. Connect PayPal in Settings before setting up payment rules.
Show subliminal messages in assigned apps. Configure messages and popup effects in Rituals.
Assign apps separately to Censor, Limits and Whispers. Selecting an app does not start the service.
Choose apps
Choose a censor style
Preview how detected content is covered. More styles, colours and categories are available in Censor.
Optional: let a keyholder approve Dom access. You can use either method, both, or neither.
Your keyholder sets a private PIN. They enter it on this phone when approving access to Dom controls.
Your keyholder adds your setup key to Google Authenticator on their phone. Ask for their current six-digit code to open Dom controls. They do not need SubHub.
Grant access for your selected features. You can skip this and finish permissions when starting a service.
Recognize content and enforce app limits in the apps you select. Enable SubHub in Android’s Accessibility settings.
Place censor overlays and effects over other apps.
Show service status, export progress and alerts. Android keeps a notification while a service is running.
No background features selected. Gallery exports will ask for access when needed.

Configure the details
Censor sets content and appearance. Limits sets allowances. Rituals contains Keyholder and effects. Settings manages apps, privacy and Wallet connections.
